sharedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: actual transparent 2.5D game character sprite atlas for Sinefine. New sprite sheet, not a UI mockup. Landscape 1536x1024, exactly 6 equal columns by 3 equal rows (18 invisible cells). One complete figure per cell, at least 12px transparent margins. Same adult anime proportions and subdued painterly softness as the small Saber style reference; never chibi, harsh outlines, bright highlights, blurred forms, dramatic shadows, weapons, cell labels or borders. Stable head/body size throughout, soft cream light and muted cool shadows. Full head, hair, hands, garment and feet inside each cell. Truly transparent background, no cast shadows, no floors, no objects except a small bowl in the eating pose.
Cell sequence MUST be:
row1: standing front, standing back, standing left profile, standing right profile, seated seiza front hands resting, seated seiza front eating rice from a small bowl.
row2: six left-profile walking phases: left foot forward CONTACT, weight SUPPORT, legs close PASSING, right foot forward CONTACT, weight SUPPORT, legs close PASSING. Visible alternating footsteps and changing support, not six identical stretched legs. Small natural arm swing.
row3: front walking left-contact, front passing with feet close, front walking right-contact, back walking left-contact, back passing with feet close, back walking right-contact.
All standing and walking figures have identical full body proportions. Seiza figures are shorter because knees are folded, not rescaled.
Reference 1 is style/proportion only. Reference 2 is character identity only; reproduce the described everyday clothing, not the reference's background or chibi proportions.

styleReference.role: Subdued painting, adult proportions; never a new character identity

No bag. Same identity, hairstyle and attire in every cell. The face is calm and reserved.
